reason: The September 2026 snapshot retains current amendments; historic publication vintages are unavailable. Errors assess latest-vintage research, not contemporaneous investment performance or 2080 accuracy.

source.attribution: Dubai Real Estate Data (dubairealestatedata.com), based on Dubai Land Department open data

policy.identity: area_id + property_type_label + reg_type_label; no project-name candidates promoted
policy.outliers: P1/P99 by calendar year/type/registration, recomputed inside each training window. Publisher quality_flags bit 4 ignored. Target uses frozen last-training-year band.
policy.trainingTargets: A four-quarter-ahead label is admitted only when its quarter has ended by the fold cutoff.
policy.features: Dated macro regime indicators with source first-known availability by each origin. No infrastructure uplift coefficients.
policy.model: Pooled ridge regression on log returns, penalty10 fixed before evaluation, intercept unpenalised, predicted log return clipped [-0.5,0.5]. Contextual statistical research; no causal attribution.

eventFeatureAudit.policy: All referenced sources must have known availability and publication no later than the forecast origin. Coarse dates are conservatively bounded; retrieval is never first-known publication.
